title: Protean CLI result envelope v0.1.0
description: The shared result envelope every Protean command emits under --json. A coarse status plus command-specific detail under data and the typed Diagnostic list. See src/protean/cli/result.py.

version.description: Semantic version of the envelope format

status.description: Coarse verdict mapping to the exit-code class: pass=0, fail=a detected failure, error=a usage/environment error

data.description: The command's own detail (permissive: it holds both check's report and verify's stage tree)

diagnostics.description: Diagnostic records (the protean.ir.diagnostics shape; may be empty)

diagnostic.description: One diagnostic record. Mirrors the IR schema's diagnostic shape so custom-lint diagnostics (which pin only code/level/message/element) still validate.
